title: Godot crashed when trying to past a node.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.dev4.official [36e6207bb]

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev4 - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 25 Nov 2024 05:29:44 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 550 / 550 Series (RADV POLARIS12) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

I was trying to copy and paste a node. I might have mitakenly had text in the copypaste clipboard, rather than the node I wanted to copy.

Godot crashed after pressing ctrl+v. Here's the resulting log:
